title: Grids and copies
description:
Fill in four functions for nested tables:

```lua-norun
make_grid(rows, cols, fill)   -- a list of rows, each a list of cols copies of fill; every row its own table
transpose(grid)               -- a NEW grid whose rows are the old columns
deep_copy(t)                  -- a copy that shares no table with t, at any depth (values that are not tables are returned as they are)
equal(a, b)                   -- true when a and b have the same contents at every depth
```

```lua-norun
transpose({ { 1, 2, 3 }, { 4, 5, 6 } })   --> { { 1, 4 }, { 2, 5 }, { 3, 6 } }
equal({ 1, { 2 } }, { 1, { 2 } })         --> true
```

Assume tables never contain themselves.

solution.solution.lua:
function make_grid(rows, cols, fill)
    local grid = {}
    for r = 1, rows do
        grid[r] = {}
        for c = 1, cols do grid[r][c] = fill end
    end
    return grid
end

function transpose(grid)
    local out = {}
    if #grid == 0 then return out end
    for c = 1, #grid[1] do
        out[c] = {}
        for r = 1, #grid do out[c][r] = grid[r][c] end
    end
    return out
end

function deep_copy(t)
    if type(t) ~= "table" then return t end
    local copy = {}
    for k, v in pairs(t) do copy[k] = deep_copy(v) end
    return copy
end

function equal(a, b)
    if type(a) ~= "table" or type(b) ~= "table" then return a == b end
    for k, v in pairs(a) do
        if not equal(v, b[k]) then return false end
    end
    for k in pairs(b) do
        if a[k] == nil then return false end
    end
    return true
end

hints: `make_grid` in the starter puts the same `row` table in every slot. Make a new `{}` for each row, inside the loop.
`deep_copy` and `equal` call themselves for every value that is a table.
unitTests:
test("every row is its own table", function()
    local g = make_grid(2, 3, ".")
    check_eq(g, { { ".", ".", "." }, { ".", ".", "." } })
    g[1][1] = "#"
    check_eq(g[2][1], ".", "changing row 1 changed row 2: the rows are the same table")
    check_eq(make_grid(0, 5, 0), {})
end)

test("transpose", function()
    check_eq(transpose({ { 1, 2, 3 }, { 4, 5, 6 } }), { { 1, 4 }, { 2, 5 }, { 3, 6 } })
    check_eq(transpose({ { 7 } }), { { 7 } })
    check_eq(transpose({}), {})
    local g = { { 1, 2 } }
    transpose(g)
    check_eq(g, { { 1, 2 } })
end)

test("deep copy shares nothing", function()
    local original = { 1, inner = { 2, deeper = { 3 } }, name = "x" }
    local copy = deep_copy(original)
    check_eq(copy, original)
    check(copy ~= original and copy.inner ~= original.inner and copy.inner.deeper ~= original.inner.deeper, "a table inside is shared")
    copy.inner.deeper[1] = 99
    check_eq(original.inner.deeper[1], 3)
    check_eq(deep_copy(5), 5)
    check_eq(deep_copy("text"), "text")
end)

test("equal compares contents", function()
    check(equal({ 1, { 2, 3 } }, { 1, { 2, 3 } }), "same contents")
    check(not equal({ 1, 2 }, { 1, 2, 3 }), "b has an extra item")
    check(not equal({ 1, 2, 3 }, { 1, 2 }), "a has an extra item")
    check(not equal({ a = { 1 } }, { a = { 2 } }), "different deep values")
    check(equal({}, {}), "two empty tables")
    check(equal(4, 4) and not equal(4, "4"), "plain values")
end)
